*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile strikes kill seven [[civilian]]s in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], including five in [[Synelnykove]] and two in [[Dnipro]], with several others critically injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68853490 (BBC News)]
